name: Server Clock
description: A clock showing NTP-synced server time, identical for every player. Runs on the Multiplayer Server.

changelog.notes: The 2D clock takes its place in the shared HUD layout, so it no longer overlaps other HUDs on any screen.
Initial release: the Multiplayer Server's NTP-synced time, identical for every player, shown as 3D text at the item or as a 2D overlay on the player's client.
Shared UI theme and independent clocks when multiple items use the overlay.
